about: Written by `python -m sonic_eval catalog`; do not edit by hand. Accuracy, English kept and Roman-only are over speech clips; silence counts clips with no speech that gave no text (before the app's voice gate); latency is clip in -> text out; usd_per_hour is per hour of speech at paid prices (0 where the price is not in the spec).

models.label: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe + Roman cleanup

limits.text: Gemini free tier: 25 requests/day (Google's own quota error, 2026-11-03), about 3-4/min (429 after 4 in a minute). Roman cleanup on Groq gpt-oss-20b (free tier: 30 requests/min, 1,000/day).

models.notes: The Gemini app's dictation model (preview). Hears Urdu / Hindi best but writes it in its own script, so a second step romanizes it; needs a Gemini and a Groq key. Paid: about $2 / $12 per 1M tokens (third-party reports). Google may use free-tier requests to improve its products, and people may review them (Gemini API terms); the paid tier does not.

models.label: Gemini 3.5 Flash

limits.text: Gemini free tier: 20 requests/day per project (Google's own quota error, 2026-11-03).

models.notes: Top accuracy, but 20 dictations a day on the free tier. Paid price not checked. Google may use free-tier requests to improve its products, and people may review them (Gemini API terms); the paid tier does not.

models.label: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite

limits.text: Gemini free tier: about 10 requests/min, 500/day (third-party guide; Google shows the real numbers only in AI Studio). Not hit with 150+ requests in a day.

models.notes: Near the top for accuracy with a usable daily limit. Some requests take 10-20 s (Google's queue). Google may use free-tier requests to improve its products, and people may review them (Gemini API terms); the paid tier does not.

models.label: Groq Whisper (fast)

limits.text: Groq free tier: 20 requests/min, 2,000/day, 7,200 audio seconds/hour, 28,800 audio seconds/day (8 hours of speech)

models.notes: Fastest (~0.3 s) but weakest on natural Urdu / Hindi; writes text on silence (the voice gate stops that).

models.label: OpenAI GPT-4o mini Transcribe + Roman cleanup

limits.text: No free tier: about $0.003 per minute of audio. Roman cleanup on Groq gpt-oss-20b (free tier: 30 requests/min, 1,000/day).
limits.source: OpenAI pricing at launch; check before use

models.notes: Half the price of GPT-4o Transcribe and as accurate here; writes text on silence.
